page.overview:
What is 72 Seasons?

72 Seasons is the first and title track off of Metallica's eleventh studio album of the same name.

It is also the fourth single from the album. The song was written and composed by James Hetfield, Lars Ulrich and Kirk Hammett.

Feeding on the wrath of man Shot down Traumatic Time haunted by the past Long gone Dogmatic Althought the die is cast Shot down Volcanic But what is done is done and done Look back Psychotic No chance before this life began

Staring into black light Dominating birthright
